newsitem.title: USA: Clear Channel to buy Eller Media - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Clear Channel to buy Eller Media - NYT.

text.p: Clear Channel Communications Inc has agreed to buy Eller Media Corp, a closely held billboard advertising company, for about $1.15 billion in cash and stock, the New York Times said Wednesday.
The paper said terms of the deal call for Clear Channel to pay $750 million in cash and $400 million in stock.
The pact remains subject to regulatory approvals and closing conditions.

Phoenix-based Eller Media is the largest outdoor advertising company in the United States, with about 50,000 display faces. The company had been considering an initial public offering and had revenues of $270 million last year, the report said.
Shares of San Antonio, Texas-based Clear Channel closed up 2-1/4 Tuesday at 44-1/8.
